text:
mohan: Heads-up — planning to bring up Seagull-8b (int8 profile) for hosted + dedicated next week. Need a quick smoke/fallback playbook and quant checks.

julia: 👍 what's the initial canary plan? hosted vs dedicated differences?

mohan: Start hosted at 1% user traffic, dedicated internal at 5% (internal traffic only). Ramp doubling every 30m if metrics stable. If P99 latency > SLA or error rate spikes, cut to 0 and fallback to Raven-13b.

ada: Quick checklist I'm thinking:
- offline evals: LM-quality subset, safety prompts, long-context QA
- regression tests: hallucination score, rouge/qa-f1 vs baseline
- perf: P50 target <120ms for short prompts, P99 <800ms (hosted), dedicated target is P99 <600ms
- cost check: token cost delta, memory/kv growth on long prompts
- quant sanity: sample decode vs fp16 to catch divergence

ryan: Add warmup steps: run 50 synthetic requests per instance after deploy to populate KV cache. Also run our log-level billing probe to estimate token rate.

mohan: Also: function-calling and streaming sanity. If streaming chunk drops >0.5% abort and roll back.

infra-bot: Deploy job seagull-8b-int8 canary started by @mohan at 2181234567 - 3 nodes (low mem)

sophie: For private/VPC customers we should require opt-in canary. No auto-routing until private acceptance test passes (security + KMS).

kevin: Fallback mapping rules:
- If error-rate > 0.5% OR latency > threshold for 3 consecutive windows -> route to Raven-13b (fp16) with 100% traffic for that customer/route.
- If quality regressions (eval delta > threshold) -> route to staged A/B with 50/50 split and surface diffs to product.

julia: What exact metrics to watch in console? I'll add dashboards:
- model_error_rate (5m)
- request_latency_p50/p90/p99
- token_rate and estimated $/1M tokens
- model_quality_regression_score (eval harness)
- stream_chunk_drop_pct

ada: Threshold proposals:
- error_rate > 0.5% (5m) = hard cut
- P99 > 2x baseline (5m) = hard cut
- eval delta (QA-F1 drop) > 3 points on core suite = hold rollout and create issue

ryan: How do we run quant sanity automatically? Suggest a smoke job: run 200 prompts from production prompt-set, compare logits/topk agreement and sample-level divergence. If sample divergence > 2% fail. Command snippet:
```
./smoke_run --model seagull-8b-int8 --prompts prod-smoke-200.json --compare-with seagull-8b-fp16 --threshold 0.02
```

mohan: Good. Also coordinate with support: pre-write canned message for customers in case we hit rollback. Template: "We detected increased latency on your route and have routed to a stable model version while we investigate. No action required; we'll follow up."

kevin: Note for Dedicated: allow burst to fp16 variant when capacity low. Routing policy: prefer cheaper int8, fallback to fp16 dedicated pool, then hosted Raven if all else fails.

julia: Timeline: deploy canary Mon 09:00 UTC, smoke tests 09:05-09:20, step ramp 09:30 onward. I'll own dashboards + alerts. @ada you own eval pass. @ryan infra handles warmup commands.

mohan: Thanks — I'll attach the eval lists and assign GH issue for rollouts. If anyone wants to add a preflight item speak now.

ada: One more: data retention for private runs — ensure logs masked and persisted per customer policy before enabling telemetry.

sophie: Will coordinate with Security for KMS signoff.

infra-bot: Canary ramp to 5% hosted at 2181234800 — health: OK, error_rate 0.08%, p99 430ms

mohan: All right, rolling. Will post final postmortem template after ramp completes.
